reasons.reason: An English statesman destroyed it in the 17th century. A Protestant Church was built here in the 19th century. The actual destruction and rebuilding occurred in the 16th and 17th centuries, respectively, but the span commits to these events in the 17th century, which is a harmful premature finalization.
